parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key='anthropic_api_key') AS value, (SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key='researcher_webhook_secret') AS guard

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 1500, tools: [{ type: 'web_search_20260209', name: 'web_search', max_uses: ($('Webhook').first().json.body.max_uses || 3) }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Search the web and list the key sources (titles and URLs) for: ' + ($('Webhook').first().json.body.query || '') }] }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const msg=$json;const content=(msg&&msg.content)||[];const seen={};const evidence=[];for(const b of content){if(b&&b.type==='web_search_tool_result'){const arr=b.content||[];for(const x of arr){if(x&&x.type==='web_search_result'&&x.url&&!seen[x.url]){seen[x.url]=1;evidence.push({source_url:x.url,source_name:'web_search',content:x.title||x.url,freshness:x.page_age||null,authority:null});}}}}return [{json:{status:evidence.length?'completed':'empty',source:'web_search',evidence_count:evidence.length,evidence:evidence}}];

const h=($('Webhook').first().json.headers)||{};const hdr=h['x-researcher-secret']||'';const guard=$input.first().json.guard||'';if(!guard||hdr!==guard){throw new Error('unauthorized: missing or bad X-Researcher-Secret');}return [{json:{value:$input.first().json.value}}];
